statusDetail: Coverage-complete representative audit of five paths/templates; membership/account, checkout, and destructive flows were not covered.

page.notes: Spanish public news site with very large server-rendered landing pages, article/category templates, advertising inventory, manifest, and crawlable HTML.

paths.description: Homepage and primary news-discovery surface; represents the highest-density landing template.
España section listing; represents section/category templates.
Current Mundial article; represents the core article-reading journey and article metadata.
Latest-news feed; represents chronological listing and late-loading stability.

findings.summary: The site does not adapt to the user’s dark color-scheme preference.
findings.evidence: Under emulated prefers-color-scheme: dark, the body remained rgb(255,255,255) with color-scheme: normal; the dark-condition screenshot is visually unchanged.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme: light dark and provide preference-driven surface, text, control, and browser-chrome colors.

findings.summary: Animations continue when reduced motion is requested.
findings.evidence: The reduced-motion probe found eight running animations, each with a 2,000 ms duration, while prefers-reduced-motion: reduce matched; the CSS feature probe found no reduced-motion rule.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a prefers-reduced-motion: reduce override that removes non-essential animations and disables auto motion.

findings.summary: Route changes are abrupt rather than continuity-preserving.
findings.evidence: Across homepage, section, listing, and article DOM/CSS probes, no view-transition CSS or API affordance was present; navigations are full-document swaps.
findings.suggestedFix: Use cross-document View Transitions for same-origin navigation, with reduced-motion-safe fallbacks.

findings.summary: The dense header does not expose scroll-state-aware behavior.
findings.evidence: Mobile screenshots show several horizontal header strips, while CSS probes found no scroll-state query or scroll-timeline behavior to reduce chrome after scrolling.
findings.suggestedFix: Collapse or simplify the header as content scrolls, preferably with declarative scroll-state/scroll-driven CSS and a static fallback.

findings.summary: Advertising reserves excessive blank space before primary content.
findings.evidence: The desktop first viewport gives roughly 300 px of central space to an empty PUBLICIDAD slot before the lead module; section and latest mobile screenshots repeat large blank ad bands. The homepage document is 96,711 px tall.
findings.suggestedFix: Collapse unfilled ad slots, cap reserved sizes responsively, and prioritise the first editorial module above secondary chrome.

findings.summary: Homepage and section templates overflow horizontally on mobile.
findings.evidence: At a 360 px viewport, layout evidence reports scrollWidth 375 px and 15 px horizontal overflow on both homepage and section.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove the fixed/min-width source of the extra 15 px and use intrinsic sizing with max-inline-size: 100%.

findings.summary: Dense cards and header modules rely on viewport styling rather than container-aware reuse.
findings.evidence: CSS feature probes across all four templates found no @container usage; the mobile header remains a clipped horizontal sequence.
findings.suggestedFix: Add container-type to reusable modules and container queries for compact card/header variants.

findings.summary: Many interactive targets are too short and keyboard focus is weak.
findings.evidence: The mobile modality probe found 72 visible targets below 44 px in at least one dimension, many navigation links only 15–21 px high; focused navigation showed only a 1 px dotted outline.
findings.suggestedFix: Increase target hit areas to about 44x44 CSS px and provide a strong, high-contrast :focus-visible treatment.

findings.summary: Largest Contentful Paint is slow on both primary templates.
findings.evidence: Mobile Lighthouse measured LCP 4.8 s on both homepage and article (performance 0.78/0.80); the raw trace measured homepage LCP 3.78 s.
findings.suggestedFix: Identify the LCP element, make it discoverable in initial HTML, preload only when warranted, and set fetchpriority=high while deferring lower-priority work.

findings.summary: The latest-news listing has poor layout stability.
findings.evidence: The 360x800 layout observer measured CLS 0.192 on /ultimas-noticias/, including a single 0.160 shift around 2.53 s.
findings.suggestedFix: Reserve dimensions for late content and ads, and stabilize fonts and injected listing modules before paint.

findings.summary: The homepage has a long critical network chain and heavy initial delivery.
findings.evidence: HAR recorded 104 requests and 1,495,760 transferred bytes, including four VeryHigh-priority parser-inserted stylesheets/fonts; Lighthouse reports LCP 4.8 s.
findings.suggestedFix: Inline only critical CSS, reduce font families/weights, defer non-critical styles and scripts, and trim the initial document/network dependency chain.

findings.summary: Image delivery lacks dimensions and responsive/modern formats.
findings.evidence: Homepage image audit found 100/100 images missing at least one dimension, 89 without srcset, 91 below-fold images without loading=lazy, and no modern-format images; the article lead image is 1800 px natural width for 650 px display.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit width and height, responsive srcset/sizes, AVIF/WebP sources, lazy-load below-fold images, and explicitly prioritize only the LCP image.

findings.summary: Accessible names and ARIA relationships are incomplete.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found missing required ARIA children, unnamed links, and images without alt on the homepage; the independent probe found two unnamed buttons and one unlabeled visible input.
findings.suggestedFix: Repair ARIA ownership, give every link/button a discernible name, label all inputs, and provide meaningful alt or empty alt for decorative images.

findings.summary: Multiple persistent navigation and call-to-action colors fail WCAG contrast.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found examples at 3.25:1 for grey headline links, 3.99:1 for white breaking-news text on red, and 2.77:1 for the membership CTA.
findings.suggestedFix: Darken foreground/background token pairs to meet 4.5:1 for normal text and verify all state variants.

findings.summary: Landmark structure and focus affordances are weak.
findings.evidence: Template probes found no main landmark and the homepage reported a highly repetitive set of nested HEADER/FOOTER landmarks; focused navigation used only a 1 px dotted outline.
findings.suggestedFix: Add one main landmark, simplify repeated landmark semantics inside cards, and strengthen :focus-visible.

findings.summary: A broken image request logs a console error.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse and HAR recorded a 404 for a January 2026 image resource on the homepage.
findings.suggestedFix: Fix or remove the stale image URL and monitor production console/network errors.

findings.summary: The representative article has no meta description.
findings.evidence: The article DOM probe returned no description, the discoverability result reports metaDescriptionPresentInRaw: null, and Lighthouse failed meta-description.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate a unique, accurate article meta description from editorial summary text.

findings.summary: Baseline security headers and cookie protections are missing.
findings.evidence: Headers evidence found no CSP, HSTS, nosniff, framing, Referrer-Policy, or Permissions-Policy. Both observed first-party cookies were not Secure and used SameSite=None.
findings.suggestedFix: Add HSTS, a restrictive CSP including frame-ancestors, nosniff, Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy; mark HTTPS cookies Secure and use Lax/Strict unless cross-site use is essential.

findings.summary: Browser-enforced defense-in-depth is absent.
findings.evidence: No CSP/frame-ancestors or X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, or HSTS was present on the main document.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy and monitor explicit browser security policies, beginning with report-only CSP before enforcement.

findings.summary: The 404 route does not clearly explain the error or recovery path.
findings.evidence: The unknown URL title says Página no encontrada, but the rendered H1 is Sucesos and the first body content is the full normal navigation/news chrome rather than a clear not-found message and recovery action.
findings.suggestedFix: Return a clear 404 heading and concise explanation with links to home, search, and key sections while preserving the HTTP 404 status.

findings.summary: Asset formats and dimensions waste bandwidth and rendering work.
findings.evidence: The homepage transfers 940,028 image bytes; image probes found no modern-format images, 89 homepage images without srcset, and an oversized 1800 px article image displayed at 650 px.
findings.suggestedFix: Adopt responsive AVIF/WebP picture sources, right-size generated variants, and add intrinsic dimensions.

findings.summary: The news experience is crawlable but exposes no structured agent actions.
findings.evidence: Discoverability is excellent (100% raw-HTML coverage), and JSON-LD is present, but navigator.modelContext/WebMCP was absent on all representative templates.
findings.suggestedFix: Treat this as an emerging opportunity: expose safe, read-only search/topic tools with WebMCP while retaining semantic HTML and JSON-LD.

findings.summary: The homepage has a disproportionately large DOM/native heap footprint.
findings.evidence: Initial heap summary contained 219,483 nodes and 16.9 MB self size; after one complete scroll/lazy-load pass it retained 445,980 nodes and 28.7 MB. Layout height was 96,711 px.
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce homepage content volume, virtualize or paginate deep feeds, and avoid creating all card/ad DOM up front.

taskList.title: Fix mobile accessibility semantics, contrast, focus and targets
Reduce LCP and stabilize late layout
Collapse empty ad inventory and reduce homepage depth
Deploy security headers and secure cookie attributes
Add preference-driven dark and reduced-motion modes
Remove mobile horizontal overflow and add container-aware variants
Repair article descriptions and broken assets
Add continuity and scroll-aware navigation polish
Explore safe read-only WebMCP news tools
